mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid when optimizing for AI Overviews in New York City?

acceptedAnswer.text: When optimizing for AI Overviews in New York City, avoid common mistakes such as inconsistent business information across various online platforms, which can confuse AI algorithms. Do not solely rely on broad, generic keywords; instead, focus on highly specific, long-tail queries relevant to NYC's diverse neighborhoods and unique local services. Overstuffing content with keywords or attempting to manipulate AI with low-quality, AI-generated text without factual backing can also be detrimental. Ensure your content is genuinely helpful, accurate, and localized to specific NYC demographics and their needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid inconsistent information, generic keywords, and low-quality, unverified content. Focus on highly specific, localized content relevant to NYC neighborhoods.
